issuing_body: U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
enforcement_authorities: White House National AI Initiative Office
compliance_deadlines: National Artificial Intelligence Initiative Act effective 1/1/2021
EO Removing Barriers to American Leadership in AI issued 1/23/2025
EO on Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy AI issued 10/30/2023, rescinded 1/20/2025
EO on Promoting Trustworthy AI in Federal Government issued 12/3/2020
implementation_notes: This is a NIST summary/landing page aggregating congressional mandates and executive orders directing NIST's AI activities. The document itself is not a binding instrument; it describes obligations placed on NIST by external legislation and executive orders. EO 14110 (Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy AI) was rescinded on 1/20/2025. The America's AI Action Plan (7/23/2025) replaces the prior administration's approach.
